Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

HOOK. EYELID

3. Material 

3.1 A/ooA-— Shall be made of stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 or 20Cr13 of 
IS : 6603-1972 ' Specification for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

3.2 Handle — ShaW conform to Type HI, H2 or H3 of IS : 7783-1975. 

4. Workmanship and Finisli 

4.1 The hook shall be finished smooth and shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks, etc. 

4.2 The edges shall be even and rounded off.

IS: 7762^^1975 

4»3 The 8hdnk of the hook shall be fixed to a handle conforming to IS : 7783-1 975. If the hook is to be 
fixed to handle of Type HI , the collar shall be 3 2 mm die. 

4.4 The silver soldering of the shank of the hook with the handle after push fitting shall be neat and 
sound. 

4.5 The hook shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment -^Ths hook shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 380 to 
420 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Per/br/nance — The hook shall be held against an edge. Gripping the handle between the fore 
fingers and the thumb, a moderate pull shall be applied along the long axis of the instrument. On f 
release of the force, the hook shall not take on a new permanent set. 



6.2 Flexibility — The handle shall be fixed in a vice so that the whole length of the blade protrudes out 
of the vice jaws in the horizontal plane and the hook tip faces upwards. A load of 1 leg shall be 
suspended from the tip of the hook. The maximum load shall gradually be attained and shall act for 
2 minutes. On completion of the test, the hook shall not show any sign of damage. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance — The hook shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as specified in 
IS : 7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel 
surgical instruments '. 

7. Marking — Each instrument shall be marked with either the manufacturer's name or initials, or trade- 
mark and the country of manufacture. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — Each instrument shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in a polyethylene 
bag avoiding contact with one another, or shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the 
supplier. The tip of the blade shall be suitably protected.
